source.head: feature/birthinfo-consent
source.title: BirthInfo: consented data wins over documents
source.intent: BirthInfo: prefer user-consented birth data (birth_info_consents) over document data; add consent endpoint.

IdentityReviewModule.name: IdentityReview
IdentityReviewModule.summary: Back-office view of a user's identity evidence for manual review.

BirthConsentStore.name: BirthConsentStore
BirthConsentStore.summary: Stores birth data the user consented to share.

BirthInfoModule.name: BirthInfo
BirthInfoModule.summary: The user's country and city of birth. Consented user data wins; documents are the fallback.

DocumentBirthExtractor.name: DocumentBirthExtractor
DocumentBirthExtractor.summary: Reads country and city of birth out of already-fetched identity data. Pure: no I/O.

ComplianceReportModule.name: ComplianceReport
ComplianceReportModule.summary: Monthly regulator report of KYC outcomes and tax residencies.

DocumentExtractor.name: DocumentExtractor
DocumentExtractor.summary: Extracts structured fields from document scans via the document-AI service.

DocumentStore.name: DocumentStore
DocumentStore.summary: Reads the user's uploaded identity documents.

IdentityModule.name: Identity
IdentityModule.summary: What the user's documents say about them (nationality, country and city of birth, ...). Expensive (DB + document-AI call), so orchestrators fetch it once and pass it down.

KycModule.name: KycCheck
KycModule.summary: Know-your-customer verification. Identity, birth info and nationality feed sanctions screening.

SanctionsScreening.name: SanctionsScreening
SanctionsScreening.summary: Screens a person against sanctions and PEP lists.

NationalityModule.name: Nationality
NationalityModule.summary: Normalises the document nationality to an ISO country record.

PersonalDetailsModule.name: PersonalDetails
PersonalDetailsModule.summary: Legal name and date of birth from documents, preferred name from the user's profile.

ProfileService.name: ProfileAssembler
ProfileService.summary: Builds the user profile. Fetches Identity once and shares it with every sub-module.

TaxResidencyModule.name: TaxResidency
TaxResidencyModule.summary: Works out tax residencies (incl. US-person status from place of birth).

TravelEligibilityModule.name: TravelEligibility
TravelEligibilityModule.summary: Visa eligibility checks and passport application prefill.
